what: Over work and post cards or slider strips (data-cursor), a 96px accent-color circle grows from 0 at the cursor position in .9s cubic-bezier(.135,.9,.15,1) and hides the system cursor. Inside the circle sits whichever icon the marker picks among ↗ (open) · ⟷ (drag) · ▶ (play). The circle follows the cursor with no lag and shrinks back to 0 on the same curve when it leaves the marker — only at 1280 and up with a mouse.

options.[data-cursor]: Inner element to float the circle — value is an icon name (arrow-up-right · drag · play)
options.from: Minimum window width to enable (px), default 1280
options.--fx-disc-size · --fx-disc-bg · --fx-dis: Circle diameter, background and icon color, default 6rem · --kf-accent · --kf-on-accent

use:
Work card
Handoff band

from.where: shared.js cursor (.js-cursor / .js-cursor-drag — over work cards · service rows · post pager · ticker)
